value: Origin (the point the machine sews around)
a good speed for suiting cloth
Suiting usually sews at 600 to 800 stitches a minute. Wool holds well; stay in the middle of the range for fine serifs. Speed advice is a rule of thumb: your machine and a test sew-out decide.
On a Brother machine, look in Settings for Max embroidery speed. A file cannot set the speed, so you set it on the machine before you start.
Times include stops to swap thread and cut it, and a quarter extra for real life.
Green is the range that sews well. Amber is a heads up, and Embroidery Studio still makes the file. Moving a slider here changes every shape of that kind.
